job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Applied AI (Customer Agent)
job.pay_full: $148,000 – $222,000 a year base pay range for US locations, plus possible annual cash bonus, equity and sign-on payments

details.about: Klaviyo helps brands use their first-party data to create personalised experiences in ecommerce and beyond. The Customer Agent team, one of the newest groups in Klaviyo's engineering organisation, is based in Boston and works in-office. It builds a conversational AI system that lets brands serve their own customers at scale, ships changes against live customer traffic and measures quality with real evaluation frameworks.
duties: Design, build and scale systems for intelligent workflows, conversational experiences, tool integrations, retrieval, onboarding, observability and multi-channel customer engagement
Build both foundational platform capabilities and customer-facing experiences that let brands launch, customise and improve their own AI agents
Tackle complex technical and product problems, develop several solution paths and weigh business and architectural trade-offs
Act as a technical leader and mentor, driving engineering quality, execution and decisions
Deploy well-designed, thoroughly tested solutions that put reliability, scalability and customer impact first
needs: 7+ years in a software engineering role
A proven record of building high-quality products and systems with clean, maintainable code
Strong end-to-end development experience, or extensive front-end and back-end experience
Experience building scalable, customer-facing systems in fast-moving product environments
Experience leading projects and being accountable for technical and business outcomes
Experience mentoring teammates or driving team-growth initiatives
Experience with code reviews and a robust testing and deployment cycle
Practical experience experimenting with LLMs, AI tooling or agentic workflows, at work or in personal projects
A strong product mindset and cross-functional collaboration
nice: Conversational AI systems, workflow engines or agentic platforms
Retrieval systems, embeddings, eval frameworks or LLM orchestration
Multi-tenant or highly configurable SaaS platforms
Observability, tracing, experimentation or AI quality tooling
details.benefits: Base pay range for US locations $148,000 – $222,000 a year; the offer depends on skills, experience, education or training, and work location. Total compensation may also include the annual cash bonus plan, equity, sign-on payments and a comprehensive range of health, welfare and wellbeing benefits based on eligibility.
notes: May require up to 10% travel (onboarding, team meetings, client or partner work, industry events)
Klaviyo encourages close-but-not-exact matches to apply
